documents.title: UNAUDITED FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER AND HALF YEAR ENDED ON 30-09-2026
Board Meeting Outcome for Board Meeting Outcome For The Approval Of Unaudited Financial Results For The Quarter And Half Year Ended On 30-09-2026
Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Premier Polyfilm Limited reported robust financial performance for FY 2025-2026, with net profit surging 22.60% to 3,188 lakhs and gross sales reaching 34,126 lakhs. Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes, supported by enhanced capacity utilization following new plant machinery commissioning. The company implemented strategic cost and margin management, secured an industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park for logistics and trading, and placed orders for new manufacturing machinery. Furthermore, the Board recommended a dividend of 15% (0.15 per equity share) for the financial year. Premier Polyfilm Limited reported its financial and operational performance for the financial year 2023-2024, highlighting an increase in net profit to Rs.

capex_expansion.claim: The company secured and took possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and commenced logistics and trading activities.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has secured and taken possession of an 18.13-acre industrial plot at SIPCOT Industrial Park and that the Company has commenced logistics and trading activities at the new unit and the billing process has also started.

capex_expansion.claim: The company placed an order for manufacturing PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine, with commercial production expected in the forthcoming quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: Further, the Company has placed an order for manufacturing of PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine and the advance payment for the same has been made. The commercial production through the said machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.

margins_costs.claim: The company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.
margins_costs.quote: The Company successfully implemented a dual strategy of procuring raw materials at highly competitive prices while maintaining stable selling prices for finished goods.

margins_costs.claim: The company strategically discontinued product lines with sub-optimal margins to concentrate on high-demand, high-profitability categories.
margins_costs.quote: This was complemented by the strategic discontinuation of product lines with sub-optimal margins, allowing for a concentrated focus on high-demand, high-profitability categories.

margins_costs.claim: The cash profit increased because the company arranged raw materials at cheaper rates, kept finished goods prices unchanged, halted production of low-profit items, and lowered finance costs by securing cheaper loans from Yes Bank Limited.
margins_costs.quote: The reasons for increase in cash profit during the current quarter and year ended on 31st March,2024 was mainly due to that company could arrange raw material at cheaper rate and sold the finished goods at existing sales prices i.e. the prices of finished goods were not changed/devalued. Secondly productions of some of the items of finished goods which were not generated good profits were stopped and to some extent company could arrange cheaper loan from other bank i.e. Yes Bank Limited and hence finance cost was also reduced.

orders_capacity.claim: Production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products grew to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational excellence was a key highlight, with production volume of PVC flooring, sheeting, and allied products growing to 29,311 metric tonnes from 28,383 metric tonnes in the prior year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 27,133 metric tonnes of PVC flooring, sheetings, films, etc., during the review period compared to 26,755 metric tonnes in the previous year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the period under review your company produced 27,133 M.T. of PVC flooring, Sheetings, Films etc. as against 26,755 M.T. produced during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Higher capacity utilization was achieved through the installation and utilization of new plant and machinery.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company achieved higher capacity utilization with the installation and utilization of new Plant & Machinery.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board recommended a dividend of 15% (Rs.0.15 per equity share of Rs. 1/-) for the financial year 2025-2026.
capital_allocation.quote: “RESOLVED THAT a dividend of 15% (Rs.0.15 per equity share of Rs. 1/-) as recommended by the Board of Directors be and is hereby declared out of the profits of the Company for the financial year 2025-2026.”

capital_allocation.claim: The Board transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves during the year.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review, the Board has transferred an amount of Rs. 400/- Lakh to General Reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a dividend of 15% amounting to Rs. 0.75 per equity share of Rs. 5 each for the year ended March 31, 2024.
capital_allocation.quote: Encouraged by the performance of the company, The Board of your company is pleased to recommend for your approval Payment of dividend @ 0.75 per equity share of Rs.5/- each (i.e. 15%) for the year ended on 31st March,2024 subject to deduction of Tax at Source

capital_allocation.claim: The company proposed the sub-division of its existing equity shares from a face value of Rs. 5 per share to Rs. 1 per share.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors at their meeting held on 17th May, 2024 considered and approved the proposal of restructuring the Share Capital of the Company by sub-dividing the existing equity shares into face value of Rs. 1/- per share in place of Rs. 5/- per share.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company received a notice from NSE regarding non-compliance with SEBI Listing Regulations due to a delay in uploading Related Party Transaction disclosures.
risks_headwinds.quote: During the year under review, the Company received a notice from the National Stock Exchange of India Limited (NSE) regarding non-compliance with the provisions of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) due to delay in uploading the Integrated Filing (XBRL) containing Related Party Transaction disclosures under Regulation 23(9) of the SEBI Listing Regulations on the NEAPS portal.

risks_headwinds.claim: The National Stock Exchange of India Limited imposed a fine of ₹50,000/- on the company, which was subsequently paid.
risks_headwinds.quote: Accordingly, NSE imposed a fine of ₹50,000/- vide its order dated 16th February, 2026. The Company has subsequently paid the said fine.

risks_headwinds.claim: Lower profitability in the past was attributed to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing.
risks_headwinds.quote: Due to economic slowdown and consequent adverse market conditions prevailing, there was lower profitability in the Company.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects commercial production through the newly ordered PVC films and paper tube manufacturing machine to commence in the forthcoming quarter.
management_commitments.quote: The commercial production through the said machine is expected to commence in the forthcoming quarter.
